fusions.name: Drawn in One Pull
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 16 damage and draws every affliction out of the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. It leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Lanced and Let
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health and bursts the poison you have drawn in around you: it deals 9 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Poisoner's Comeuppance
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each affliction laid on you has a 60% chance to spring back onto whoever inflicted it, and your poison resistance rises by 20%.

fusions.name: Spent Dose Returned
fusions.desc: When a condition you inflicted runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
